identity_check: Confirmed as Tractian (tractian.com; LinkedIn and Y Combinator profiles both link tractian.com), the Atlanta-headquartered industrial condition-monitoring and maintenance company founded in 2019 by Brazilian founders Igor Marinelli (CEO), Gabriel Lameirinhas and Leonardo Vieira; Y Combinator Winter 2021. Its Brazilian operating entity is Tractian Tecnologia LTDA, São Paulo (CNPJ 35.755.699/0001-84, tractian.com/sobre). All round pages describe the same company (AI monitoring of industrial machinery / maintenance). Category kept adjacent, layer plant_ops: Tractian's wedge is sensor hardware plus AI failure diagnostics and CMMS for maintenance teams, which overlaps Utopian's maintenance agent but not procurement, RFQ/BOM or the WhatsApp agent model; it now markets itself as 'Physical AI for asset-heavy operations' across manufacturing, data centers, mining and government.

company.name: Tractian
company.description: Atlanta-based maker of wireless sensors and AI software for industrial condition monitoring, failure diagnosis and maintenance management.

layer_detail: Maintenance / condition monitoring: vibration, ultrasound, electrical and process sensors + AI failure detection + CMMS
product_summary: Plug-and-play sensors capture vibration, ultrasound, temperature, electrical and PLC/process signals; AI detects and diagnoses developing machine failures, prescribes fixes and reports downtime avoided, while a CMMS handles work orders, spare parts, preventive schedules and maintenance KPIs, integrating with SAP, NetSuite and IBM Maximo.

open_items: Seed rounds ($500K Oct 2020, $3M Apr 2021) come only from Startup Intros; its investor lists for those rounds (and its 25-name Series B / 15-name Series C lists) look aggregated across rounds and were not corroborated, so they were left out. No press page for the seeds was readable.

CB Insights shows 11 fundings including an 'Incubator/Accelerator - III' row (2022-07-01) and a $23.62M Brazilian Development Bank (BNDES) loan dated 2026-08-04; the loan is debt and not recorded as a round; the other rows are paywalled.
Series D valuation: release says the round 'values the company at $1.4 billion' without saying pre- or post-money; recorded as post-money.
AJC (Feb 2026) cites a $720M valuation 'after being founded in 2019'; round it attaches to not stated, not recorded.
Y Combinator's participation: YC Winter 2021 batch (YC profile) and named in Series A and Series D; YC's initial investment amount/date not found.
Revenue not publicly reported (no ARR figure in any fetched page).
Pricing: tractian.com/en/solutions/pricing gives no list prices ('Asset-based pricing, scoped to your operation'); left null.
Forbes Series C article returned 403; startupi.com.br seed article returned 503.
Web-search budget ran out during research; earlier-round investor lists may be fuller in pages not reached.
